description: Status-code to error-classification map. Every SDK serves each case from a stub server and asserts the same two things: which error variant surfaces, and whether the client retried. The names below are logical; each SDK maps them to its own type (FyuzRateLimitError, ErrRateLimited, Error::RateLimited, ...).

notes.retryable: The client retries the request up to max_retries times with exponential backoff and full jitter, honouring Retry-After when present. Non-retryable statuses surface on the first response.
notes.message: null means the body is not JSON and no message can be parsed out of it; the SDK falls back to a status-derived message rather than inventing one.
notes.rate_limit: The production API allows 120 requests per minute per IP.
